ui.chat.tags.label: Tags
ui.chat.tags.mode_hint: Tag groups use Time section grouping.
ui.chat.tags.discovery: Right-click a conversation and choose Tags… (Shift+F10).
ui.chat.tags.picker_description: Choose tags, then Apply. New tags are saved immediately.
ui.chat.tags.empty: No tags yet. Create a tag to get started.
ui.chat.tags.delete_description: Remove this tag from {count, plural, one {# conversation} other {# conversations}}. Conversations will not be deleted.
ui.chat.tags.manage_description: Create, rename and order tags. This does not change an explicit primary tag.
